name: commitKeyDamageRecoveryGc
covers: the commit key is damaged silently between two collection batches and a recovery exit starts: its fence listing covers the keys the second batch is about to delete

labels.GC pass: first batch of 25: g: open, gc: the first retireChecked of the pass, applied before the damage
labels.ENV: commit key DAMAGED (silent: the rev: environment step damage-commit, after g's first batch is applied
labels.recovery exit: list, fence create, marke: r: open, then recover once the damage is applied: the exit's fence write lists the five keys still standing, then its marker (held until g's second batch is applied)
labels.GC pass: second batch of 5: g: the second retireChecked, held until r's fence write is applied; it carries the fence version it read before the exit
